media.title: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar — Films Division Documentary
media.collection: Films Division of India / Indian Diplomacy
media.description: The official Films Division biographical documentary on Dr. Ambedkar, released on the MEA channel for Constitution Day.

media.title: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar (2000) — Feature Film
media.collection: Dir. Jabbar Patel · NFDC / Govt. of India
media.description: The National Award-winning biographical film starring Mammootty as Dr. Ambedkar, tracing his life from childhood to the framing of the Constitution.

media.title: B. R. Ambedkar — Now and Then
media.description: A feature-length documentary exploring Dr. Ambedkar's life and continuing political relevance.

media.title: The Man Who Wrote India's Destiny
media.description: A short film on Dr. Ambedkar's journey from discrimination to becoming the principal architect of the Constitution.

media.title: Speech in the Constituent Assembly, 17 December 1946
media.collection: Prasar Bharati Archives / All India Radio
media.description: Restored All India Radio recording of Dr. Ambedkar addressing the Constituent Assembly during the debate on the Objectives Resolution.

media.title: The Immortal Voice of Dr. Ambedkar (English)
media.description: One of the few surviving recordings of Dr. Ambedkar's own voice, speaking in English on democracy and social justice.

media.title: BBC Radio Interview, 1955
media.description: Dr. Ambedkar in conversation with the BBC, including his much-quoted assessment of Gandhi and Indian politics.

media.title: Portrait of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
media.description: The widely reproduced formal portrait of Dr. Ambedkar from around the time he served as first Law Minister of India.

media.title: The Drafting Committee of the Constitution
media.description: The Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly, with Dr. Ambedkar as chairman at the centre.

media.title: Presenting the Final Draft of the Constitution
media.description: Dr. Ambedkar presenting the final draft of the Constitution to Constituent Assembly President Dr. Rajendra Prasad on 25 November 1949.

media.title: Drafting Committee Constituted, 29 August 1947
media.description: The committee photographed on the day it was formed by the Constituent Assembly, with Dr. Ambedkar as chairman.

media.title: Dr. Ambedkar with Colleagues
media.description: A group photograph of Dr. Ambedkar with political and legal contemporaries in the early years of the Republic.
